requestBody.description: JSON request body. An image becomes the avatar's original look. A video of a person becomes an uploaded talking loop, its first frame becomes the first look (the cover), and, unless clone_voice is false, its audio is cloned into a new voice that becomes the avatar's primary voice. Cloning a voice uses credits and needs a paid plan; uploading and extracting the frame do not. Send an Idempotency-Key header to retry safely. Refusals: 422 video_has_no_audio, video_too_short_for_voice_clone (the clone needs at least 30 seconds of speech) and video_audio_unreadable (each with param content_resource_id) when clone_voice is true; without clone_voice those videos are created without a voice and voice_clone_message says why.

agent_id.description: Agent context; the controller reads params[:agent_id] (`require_agent!`).

name.description: Avatar name. Optional: defaults to the file name, else "New avatar".

content_resource_id.description: An uploaded image (becomes the original look) or video of a person (becomes a talking loop, its first frame the first look, and its audio a cloned voice unless clone_voice is false).

clone_voice.description: Videos only (ignored for images). Default true: clone the person's voice from the video's audio into the avatar's primary voice; this uses credits. false skips it. true refuses a video without audio or shorter than 30 seconds instead of creating it without a voice.

voice_gender.description: The cloned voice's gender label. Default female.

voice_language.description: The cloned voice's language. Default english.
